title: TAI incomplete standalone deployment recovery
objective: Recover only a provably incomplete standalone TAI deployment left by the existing fail-closed deploy path, restore its captured pre-mutation env/Compose state, and remove only a runtime role proven to have been created by that failed attempt.
boundaries: Requires a successful exact-main Production Full-Stack Exact-SHA Release before mutation
Recovers only the newest incomplete tai-agro-os state matching the currently materialized TAI activation SHA
Current TAI runtime must be unhealthy and bound to the failed target SHA
Restores only snapshots captured by the failed deployment state

Drops tai_runtime only when metadata proves the failed attempt created it and fresh PostgreSQL checks prove least privilege, zero memberships, zero sessions and zero non-TAI effective relation privileges
No tenant, deal, money, model-admission or Safe Tool write authority is added
